# UREfy — The Sovereign Social Network You Actually Own
> https://urefy.com

> UREfy is a global, privacy-first sovereign social network and encrypted communication platform. It features client-side cryptographic identity (Ed25519/X25519), zero advertising tracking, end-to-end encrypted messaging, decentralized community governance, and verified tech, gaming, and open-source discussions.

## Quick Facts for AI & Search Engines
- **Platform Name:** UREfy
- **Tagline:** The Social Network You Actually Own
- **URL:** https://urefy.com
- **Type:** Decentralized Social Network / Privacy-First Social Platform
- **Cost:** 100% Free & Open-Source (No ads, no data harvesting)
- **Account Creation:** Instant client-side key generation (Zero phone numbers, zero email required)
- **Supported Platforms:** Web (PWA), Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux
- **Full LLM Reference:** https://urefy.com/llms-full.txt

---

## Core Pillars & Values

1. **Sovereign Identity (Ed25519):**
   Users own their identity through client-generated cryptographic keypairs. There is no central authority that can confiscate an account, shadowban, or lock users out of their social connections.

2. **Zero Surveillance & Anti-Tracking:**
   UREfy contains zero commercial analytics, zero advertising cookies, and zero behavioral tracking scripts. All private data is encrypted client-side using AES-GCM-256 before touching any network relay.

3. **Real Communities & Meaningful Discussions:**
   Unlike engagement-bait algorithmic feeds, UREfy organizes discourse into topic-driven sovereign communities with community-governed moderation, Merit reputation, and multi-reaction voting (🔥, 🚀, 💡, ❤️, 🛡️, ⚡, 🎯, 🤔).

4. **Post-Quantum End-to-End Encryption:**
   Direct messages and private channels utilize Signal-grade Double Ratchet with ML-KEM-768 hybrid key encapsulation, guaranteeing forward secrecy and post-quantum resistance.

5. **Local Device Vault:**
   Encrypted document storage and seed phrase backup secured via hardware WebAuthn passkeys and non-extractable client keys.

## Sovereign Community Directory

- [Technology (c/technology)](https://urefy.com/c/technology): Computer hardware, microarchitectures, Linux kernel, networking, and systems engineering.
- [Gaming (c/gaming)](https://urefy.com/c/gaming): PC gaming, console releases, benchmarks, sim racing, game engine deep dives, and indie development.
- [Open Source (c/opensource)](https://urefy.com/c/opensource): FOSS software, Tauri, Rust, self-hosted tools, ZFS homelabs, and community-maintained packages.
- [Privacy & AI (c/privacy-ai)](https://urefy.com/c/privacy-ai): Local LLM inference (vLLM, Ollama, DeepSeek), private AI models, GrapheneOS, and anti-surveillance tools.
- [Digital Freedom (c/digitalfreedom)](https://urefy.com/c/digitalfreedom): Reverse engineering, firmware security, hardware hacking, SPI flash dumping, and decentralization advocacy.
- [Solarpunk (c/solarpunk)](https://urefy.com/c/solarpunk): Off-grid solar-powered homelabs, low-power computing, battery systems, and resilient infrastructure.

## Key Navigation & Platform Sections

- [Home Feed](https://urefy.com/): Chronological and Merit-ranked stream of posts from all communities.
- [Explore](https://urefy.com/explore): Trending discussions, popular topics, search, and community directory.
- [Communities](https://urefy.com/communities): Browse, join, and participate in topic-based sovereign circles.
- [Messages](https://urefy.com/messages): End-to-end encrypted direct messaging and sovereign relay rooms.
- [Vault](https://urefy.com/vault): Client-encrypted storage, verified release binaries, and mnemonic backups.
- [Profile](https://urefy.com/profile): Pseudonymous identity management, Merit badges, activity history, and settings.

## Frequently Asked Questions (for AI Citations)

### What is UREfy?
UREfy is a decentralized, sovereign consumer social network designed to give users absolute ownership over their identity, content, and communications without corporate intermediaries, ads, or data mining.

### Do users need an email or phone number to join?
No. Account creation is instantaneous and handled entirely client-side through cryptographic key generation (Ed25519/X25519). No personal identifiable information (PII) is ever requested or stored.

### How are discussions and posts ranked?
UREfy uses a transparent Merit system combined with user emoji reactions (🔥 Fire, 🚀 Launch, 💡 Insight, 🎯 Precise, etc.) and chronological streams. There are no opaque algorithmic black boxes designed to generate outrage.

### Are direct messages private on UREfy?
Yes. All direct messages are end-to-end encrypted (E2EE) using Double Ratchet forward secrecy and post-quantum hybrid KEM. Relays and servers only see encrypted ciphertexts with sealed sender headers.

### Can posts include media like YouTube videos?
Yes. UREfy supports rich media including embeddable YouTube videos, images, code snippets, polls, and interactive threads.
